scripts.build:client: OTT_EDGE_PREVIEW=true GIT_COMMIT=cloudflare-preview-0.1.2 VITE_SOURCE_URL=/source-code.tar.gz yarn workspace ott-client build && cp assets/_headers ../../client/dist/_headers
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply ott-edge-preview --remote --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
scripts.test: wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist --assets tests/assets && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs
